how it works

From signal to fix in seconds.

01

Connect your stack

Plug into Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Datadog, or any of 13 connectors. No data leaves your infra unless you want it to.

02

Baselines, automatically

Adaptive EMA baselines calibrate to your traffic patterns. No manual threshold tuning. No alert storms.

03

Insight, not noise

When something breaks, Prescient investigates — correlating signals, searching incident memory, generating a root cause hypothesis.

04

Fixes, risk-gated

Low-risk remediations execute automatically. Medium gets a Slack notification with a 60s undo window. High or critical always require your approval.
